scale_cues: Square white dinner plate assumed about 25-27 cm across; the food covers roughly the central third of the plate. Individual rice grains and leaf sizes used as secondary cues.
assumptions: Dark browned pieces at lower left and the golden piece in the centre are grilled chicken; they could be another meat or roasted mushroom/eggplant.
Rice is brown rice, cooked without significant added fat.
Greens are lightly dressed with an oil-based vinaigrette; the amount is inferred from the sheen, not directly visible.
Red pieces are tomato or red bell pepper.
Dark green charred spear at the bottom is asparagus.
Low image resolution limits identification of the darker items.
